snippet.title: Blinding Oversight - Full Release Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1871110/Blinding_Oversight/

Blinding Oversight is a linear, atmospheric horror game that focuses on our protagonist, Emma Yang, who wakes up in an abandoned wooden house without any prior memory of how she ended up there. Investigate your surroundings, uncover the mysteries of the house and connect memories from your past as you guide Emma to her freedom!

Song Used:
the flooded basement by Katarina Rose- https://on.soundcloud.com/fGEYLnuMGvHF5MmrLb
